title: Localize provider selection and diagnostics guidance
context: ProvidersScreen renders model-selection guidance and troubleshooting diagnostics using LocalizedStringKey, but many Vietnamese keys lack English catalog values, so English mode still displays Vietnamese-only guidance.
goal: Add English and Vietnamese localization catalog entries for provider selection guidance and common connection/chat diagnostics.
forbidden_changes: Do not change provider selection, network requests, credential handling, or runtime behavior.
Do not weaken guidance against logging secrets.
Do not change existing Vietnamese wording.
acceptance_criteria: Provider guidance and diagnostic headings/details have entries in both catalogs.
English values are natural English; Vietnamese values preserve the current wording.
No duplicate localization keys are introduced.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Static duplicate-key scan for both localization catalogs
recovery: Revert the single task commit if localization lookup or the Apple build regresses.
